profile.headline: Junior AI/Data Engineer with 2+ years experience for production development with Knowledge Graph, DevOps automation, and data pipeline building with technologies including GenAI, Neo4j, Ollama, LLMs, HuggingFace ChatUI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
ISG Developer Experience Project​:
•     Platform built to modernize and streamline the software development experience      
•     Integrated RAG System backend with HuggingFace ChatUI
•     Customized NodeJS-based chatbot UI by creating custom endpoints for RAG system
•     Built Ollama/Llama3 backend RAG system with Neo4j backend storage for graph data
 
Graph Modeling for Kubernetes Service Dependency Map​:
•     Proactive service dependency map – created from source code
•     Built knowledge graph and stored using Neo4j graph DB with UI
•     Integrated with Large-Language Models as RAG system to answer questions and navigate the knowledge graph
•     Leveraged open-source alternative to Neo4j using Pometry graph DB
•    US patent in pending status in the related area 
 
Automation and Deployment of Microservice:
• Integrated internal service into Jenkins CI/CD pipeline
• Configured Helm charts for the service to deploy to the appropriate environments
 
Kubernetes Resource Utilization Forecasting/Planning​:
•     Maintained 2 Data Mover microservices to obtain Kubernetes node and cluster metrics
•     Trained ARIMA model on historical metric data to forecast future consumption to be used in IT resource planning
•    US patent in pending status in Data Cleaning 
 
Model Evaluation Platform​:
•     Adapted EvalAI open-source model evaluation platform to run on private server for hosting Kaggle-like platform
•     Obtained open-source security approval through internal process
 
Research Project: 
•     Full-stack development to create UI and backend code for cloud offering platform
•     Backend – Golang
•     Frontend – Angular and Typescript
positions.insights: Data Engineering, Graph Databases and +15 skills

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Help train new freshman researchers in the lab
Oversee safe lab protocol to ensure safety
Participate in a research project to isolate novel antibiotic compound
Grade assignments submitted by students in the lab and provide feedback for improvement
Assist Research Educator in current research projects
Present research progress at conferences and forums

positions.title: Office of the Dean of Students Central Administration Student Assistant
positions.description:
Created a yearly proposed budget for the Office of the Dean of Students.
Processed and disposed of confidential documents.
Maintained events planning calendar for all areas of the Office of the Dean of Students.
Transported important university officials, including the Vice President of Student Affairs.
Researched historical topics for projects assigned by the dean of students.
Assisted in planning conference travel and attendance for the dean of students.
Helped train new student assistants.
